title: The Startup Leap — 26-minute book-review podcast: 'Why culture alone isn't enough'
summary: The Startup Leap releases a 26-minute Incorruptible book-review podcast focused on Costco's $1.50 hot dog, Cloudflare's commitment to protecting users, mission guardians, golden shares, and the spiritual holding company.
blockquote: From Costco's legendary $1.50 hot dog to Cloudflare's commitment to protecting the internet, Eric reveals why culture alone isn't enough — and why the future of capitalism may depend on something far less discussed: structure.
